    StartersFezziwig's ball pork and sage rollsPork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastryHow to make it500g pork mince1 apple, grated1 onion, grated2 tbsp chopped sage40g breadcrumbs2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beaten150g apple chutney1 tbsp wholegrain mustardMix the pork with the apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper.Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath.Brush with egg and cut each into small rolls.Bake at 200°C until golden.Stir the mustard into the chutney and serve alongside.Brown butter roast chestnutsRoasted chestnuts tossed in brown butter, rosemary and sea saltHow to make it600g fresh chestnuts40g butter1 sprig rosemary, chopped1 tsp sea salt flakesCut a cross through the shell on the flat side of each chestnut.Soak in water, then drain.Roast on a tray at 200°C until the shells peel back.Wrap in a tea towel to steam, then peel while warm.Melt the butter until golden brown, add the rosemary and toss the chestnuts through with sea salt. Serve in paper cones.MainsScrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffingButter roast turkey breast with sage and onion stuffingHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast70g butter150g breadcrumbs1 onion, diced1 small bunch sage, chopped1 egg1kg potatoes3 tbsp vegetable oil3 apples, peeled and diced2 tbsp caster sugar1 tbsp plain flour400ml chicken stockRub the turkey with some of the butter, salt and pepper.Roast at 180°C.Fry the onion in butter, mix with the breadcrumbs, sage and egg, press into a dish and bake alongside for the last part of the roasting. Roast the potatoes in oil.Simmer the apples with the sugar and water until soft.Rest the turkey. Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.Fred's Christmas party roast beef and Yorkshire puddingsFred's party, where Scrooge finally turns up for dinnerHow to make it1.2kg beef sirloin roast1kg potatoes, in chunks4 carrots, halved4 tbsp vegetable oil2 eggs100g plain flour200ml milk400ml beef stock1 tbsp plain flour, extra1 tbsp honeyHeat the oven to 220°C. Whisk the eggs, flour and milk into a batter and rest.Season the beef, sear it, then roast with the potatoes and carrots tossed in half the oil until pink inside.Rest the beef. Turn the oven to 230°C, heat the rest of the oil in a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake until puffed.Stir the extra flour and stock into the roasting tin juices and simmer for gravy. Glaze the carrots with honey.SweetsCratchit Christmas pudding with custardSteamed Christmas pudding with warm vanilla custardHow to make it800g Christmas pudding500ml full cream milk300ml thickened cream4 eggs (yolks only)60g caster sugar1 tbsp cornflour1 tsp vanilla extract1 tbsp icing sugar1 orange, zestedSteam the pudding over simmering water, or follow the packet.Warm the milk with some of the cream. Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour in the milk while whisking and return to the pan.Stir until thick, then add the vanilla.Whip the remaining cream with the icing sugar and orange zest.Turn out the pudding, top with a holly sprig and serve with both.DrinksSmoking bishop spiced orange punchWarm red grape juice with roasted clove oranges, apple and gingerHow to make it2 oranges12 cloves1 L red grape juice250ml apple juice2 cinnamon sticks2 tbsp honey1 knob ginger, slicedStud the oranges with the cloves and roast at 200°C until browned.Slice them into a saucepan with the grape juice, apple juice, cinnamon, honey and ginger.Heat gently without boiling.Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange slice in each.Hot spiced milk with nutmegPoured for the dancers between reels.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
